lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Bruna Viana da Silva Rocha | Lesson 6 -- You Should Have Packed That

listenings.text: Hey, it is me, I am at the airport, do not panic. Okay, panic a little. So the flight got canceled, not delayed, canceled, and the line at the desk is about two hundred people long. Here is where I am. They have me on the six forty tomorrow morning for free, or I can pay two hundred and ten dollars and take the red-eye tonight, which gets in at five in the morning and I would go straight to the thing. I do not have travel insurance, before you ask. I know. You told me. I have about nine percent battery and I should have brought the charger, so if this cuts off, that is why. Just tell me what you would do. Call me back.

Good afternoon, this message is for passenger Rocha. I am calling from baggage services about the bag you reported this morning. Good news first. It was not lost. It went to terminal four with a connecting flight, which happens more than we would like. Here is what I need from you. You do not have to come back to the airport. We can deliver it tonight between seven and eleven, but I have to confirm the address with you by phone before nine, and the number we have on file is not answering. If we do not hear from you by nine, the bag goes into storage and it is a twenty-four hour wait, and honestly, you should not have to do that after the day you have had. One more thing. If anything inside is damaged, keep the tag. You must have the tag to file a claim. Call us back at the number on your receipt.
